item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**, the advanced air sealing upgrade:

- **Applies to:** Homes with baseline infiltration rates of **6 ACH50 or greater**.
- **Seals them to:** **5 ACH50**—five air changes per hour at a pressure difference of 50 pascals. [Release README](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf)
- **Covers:** Approximately **92% of dwelling units** (**92.2%** of baseline units). Homes below 6 ACH50 are excluded. [Measure documentation](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96281.pdf)
